description: Hand-authored: the adapter's generated file enumerates every prerendered path and static asset, which breaks Cloudflare's 100-rule cap as the corpus grows. Everything matching an exclude is served static; the rest hits the worker. An on-demand route (the API, error pages, the retired per-repo sitemap 410 under /sitemaps/<owner>/<repo>.xml) needs the worker, so /sitemaps/* must stay included. A prerendered path that reaches the worker is served straight from the ASSETS binding by the adapter, BEFORE Astro middleware runs: it writes no Analytics Engine row and pays an invocation for nothing. Routing robots.txt, the sitemap index, the shards and /repos/* to the worker (2026-09-14) was done to make Google's sitemap fetches measurable; it never did (3-day AE query 2026-09-22: 0 rows for any of them while Search Console showed shard downloads), so the prerendered crawl-facing paths are excluded again. Sitemap fetch evidence lives in Search Console (scripts/gsc.py sitemaps) and Bing Webmaster Tools (scripts/bing.py), not here. /data/* stays excluded as the dataset the MCP pulls; adding it would need a day of invocation monitoring first.
